<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->

This implements trailing stop orders, a type of stop orders thart work like `StopMarketOrders`, except that the stop price is updated to follow the highest high (for sells) or lowes low (for buy) prices in order to protect profits.

The following chart shows how the trailing amount changes for an SPY sell order with an trailing amount of $20 for a daily algorithm:
![chart (12)](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/72f267a3-f8e2-4c3f-8af4-d4f873a93a49)

This chart shows the same info as the one above, alongside the market prices at each time the stop price was updated (in red line):
![chart (13)](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/98f7d1aa-f677-4be1-9cb2-97cdd9bd7728)

The same is shown next for a buy order:

![chart (14)](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/3ea1cac3-e078-4b05-959b-2c63e55ecb3e)
![chart (15)](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/c9dc4903-dbcb-4236-8ebd-722be231088b)

Support trailing stop orders for backtesting and live trading (IB).

issue_context.title: Add support for Trailing Stop Orders
issue_context.body:
It would be great to support for Trailing Stop Orders.

Past discussion here: https://www.quantconnect.com/forum/discussion/601/trailing-orders

Using the Algorithm Framework would this best be implemented as:
- New Order Type
- Risk Management Model
- Execution Model
comments: @jaredbroad this is super super important for live trading! I did implement a trailing stop algo in my live trade, but it could fail for all sorts of issues. The most important reason for QC to support trailing stop on live is it reduces the unreliability by a huge degree for it eliminates all the possible issues such as server goes offline, network unavailable, market data not available, etc. I'm hoping you can take this into consideration to get more Ib order type implemented(most important are stop loss and trailing stop loss). Again, I do think it is essential for live trading. Please do consider offer this!
